facts.fact: The criminal chamber of the Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité had 4 cases involving 8 accused on its roll at a session reported on 21 May 2026, with charges including insults, threats, undermining state security via an information system, ICT-enabled fraud and conspiracy to commit computer offences; the document gives no session date, so its published date is used.
